name: record_invoice
title: Record invoice
description: Enter a supplier invoice into accounts payable (status RECEIVED). Give the fields as printed on the invoice; the supplier may be a name or a code. confirm=false previews. A supplier invoice number already recorded is refused with ledgerline_code DUPLICATE: never record or pay an invoice twice.

supplier.description: supplier name or code as on the invoice, e.g. 'Voltway Cells'

po_no.description: the purchase order the invoice quotes, e.g. PO/2026/01133

unit_price.description: price per unit in pounds, before VAT

vat.description: optional VAT amount as printed (0 for reverse charge)

source_message_id.description: optional: the e-mail it came in, e.g. MSG-0007 (marked done)

confirm.description: false (default) = preview only, nothing is saved; true = commit

ok.description: true when it worked; false comes with error and next_step

policy.on_lost_write_reply: never resent blindly: look the document up (by the supplier's number or its id) and return it
policy.on_busy_before_write: ok=false with next_step; nothing was saved, so the same call is safe to repeat
